facts_of_case: Matrimonial dispute between the parties with proceedings pending before Mahila Court and Family Court. The present petition is for taking action for criminal contempt against the respondent/husband.

legal_principles.principle: The court may refer a matter to mediation and appoint a counsellor for bringing about a resolution between the parties.
legal_principles.held: On 5th July, 2024, this Court, after hearing the parties, referred the matter to mediation and also directed appointment of a Counsellor for bringing about some resolution between the parties including the two children and the father/Respondent.
cited_cases: Shikha Kanwar vs Rajat Kanwar on 29 July, 2024

legal_principles.principle: A party may be directed to clear arrears of maintenance before the next date of hearing.
legal_principles.held: The entire school fees arrears for the CBSE course, if any, shall be cleared by the Respondent/Contemnor before the next date of hearing.
cited_cases: Shikha Kanwar vs Rajat Kanwar on 29 July, 2024
